name: liuminxin45/podflow-studio
summary: 发布者将 Podflow Studio 描述为本地优先的新闻播客工作台，涵盖素材研究、事实卡片整理、口播稿撰写、分段配音、音质检查及 RSS 发布包准备，正式发布前由人工终审。

The publisher describes Podflow Studio as a local-first workspace for researching news, organizing fact cards, drafting scripts, producing voiceovers in segments, checking audio quality, and preparing an RSS publishing package for final human review.
